This is a second-price sealed-bid auction. In such auctions, the dominant strategy for a bidder is to bid their true private value. Bidding higher than your value risks a loss if the second-highest bid is between your value and your bid. Bidding lower than your value increases the chance of losing the item to someone with a lower value than yours, missing out on potential profit.
